description: Attackers may attempt to bypass access controls to directly access documents stored in S3 buckets, potentially leading to data breaches.
Attackers may attempt to inject malicious SQL code through document metadata fields that are stored in the RDS database.
Document contents or PII might be inadvertently logged to CloudWatch Logs through application logging or Lambda function execution logs.
Insufficient key rotation and management practices could lead to prolonged exposure if encryption keys are compromised.
Inadequate session management could allow attackers to hijack user sessions or perform replay attacks.
Race conditions in the document processing pipeline could lead to data corruption or processing errors.
Improper access controls on document references could allow unauthorized access to documents through URL manipulation.
